name: body pain overview
title: Body pain without swollen joints: normal inflammatory markers with widespread, migratory pain is fibromyalgia, a central pain syndrome; an older patient with shoulder and hip girdle stiffness and high markers has polymyalgia rheumatica; myositis, inflammatory arthritis, osteoarthritis, cancer and infection are the mimics, each told apart by what PMR lacks; each column gives the presentation, the same row of labs, and treatment

nodes.title: Pain all over WITHOUT swollen joints: ESR, CRP and CK sort it
lines: first: ESR, CRP · CBC · CK · RF, ANA only if the exam points there
none of the mimics respond as fast or as dramatically to prednisone as PMR

nodes.title: ESR, CRP **NORMAL** · CK normal
lines: • CBC normal
• a + RF or ANA doesn't exclude it
• diagnose by the **2010 criteria**

nodes.title: ESR + CRP **HIGH** · CK NORMAL
lines: • Hb ↓ · platelets ↑
• RF, CCP **−**
• Avery: ESR 73, CRP 65
• Hb 103, platelets 489

nodes.title: **CK HIGH**
lines: • ESR ↑ in half
• ANA 80% · **anti-Jo-1**

nodes.title: **RF, anti-CCP +** · ESR, CRP ↑
lines: • joint fluid **inflammatory**

nodes.title: Everything **NORMAL**
lines: • joint fluid **< 2000**

nodes.title: **Gram, culture +** · or cancer screen +
lines: • ESR, CRP ↑

nodes.title: Fibromyalgia
lines: CENTRAL pain · 1 in 100, mostly women

nodes.title: Polymyalgia rheumatica
lines: over 50 · muscles NORMAL · linked to GCA

nodes.title: Inflammatory myositis
lines: proximal WEAKNESS · CK ↑

nodes.title: Inflammatory arthritis
lines: DISTAL joints swollen

nodes.title: Osteoarthritis
lines: WORSE with activity

nodes.title: Cancer or infection
lines: why markers are never treated alone

nodes.title: Widespread pain, 3+ months
lines: • 'I hurt everywhere' · 'it hurts to be hugged'
• exhausted · 'fog' · unrefreshed after 8 hours' sleep
• light, noise, smells bother · waxes, wanes, migrates
• jaw, bowel, bladder, chest pain, headache: other specialists first

nodes.title: 2010 criteria: all three
lines: • pain index 7+ and severity 5+, or index 3-6 and severity 9+
• at a similar level for 3+ months · nothing else explains it
~ NOT a diagnosis of exclusion: often fibromyalgia PLUS another disease

nodes.title: Shoulders, neck, hips: pain + stiffness
lines: • PROFOUND morning stiffness · insidious
• NO weakness · exam normal apart from pain
• fatigue, weight loss, low fever, night sweats
case: Avery, 70: stiff shoulders for 3 months, lost 10 lb

nodes.title: New headache, jaw claudication, vision?
lines: giant cell arteritis: high-dose prednisone TODAY (see VASCULITIS)

nodes.title: ASYMMETRIC · other symptoms
lines: • infection: a warm, swollen joint

nodes.title: 1 · Education + EXERCISE (best evidence)
lines: • graded · Tai Chi, yoga, warm pool
• CBT: sleep hygiene, pacing, mindfulness
• treat other inputs: sleep apnea, OA, mood, RA, IBD

nodes.title: 2 · One drug, low dose, slow
lines: • duloxetine (best evidence), venlafaxine · no help for sleep
• pregabalin, gabapentin · HELP sleep
• low-dose amitriptyline: pain, fatigue, sleep · not mood
~ half get a 30% improvement

nodes.title: NEVER opioids
lines: no better for pain · worse sleep and disability

nodes.title: 1 · Prednisone 15-20 mg a day
lines: • better within 48 hours (Avery: 12 hours)
• hold until well + markers normal, 1-2 months

nodes.title: No dramatic response in 3 days → rethink
2 · Taper slowly
lines: • 15 → 12.5 → 10 mg, a month each, then ↓ 1 mg a month (16-18 months)
• about 2 years on steroids · relapses common
• over 7.5 mg for over 3 months: calcium 1500 mg, vitamin D 1000-2000 IU, antiresorptive

nodes.title: Never treat raised markers alone
lines: exclude cancer and infection first

nodes.title: Find and treat the cause
lines: before any steroid
